*Company Achieved +127% Quarter-over-Quarter Growth in Revenue and Gross Profit; +143% Quarter-over-Quarter Growth in Adjusted Gross Profit(1)*


*Scaling DeFi Businesses Generated ~3.6x Base Staking Yield in Q3*


*All Legacy Debt Retired and Share Repurchases Commenced*


DALLAS, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hyperion DeFi, Inc. (NASDAQ: HYPD) (“Hyperion DeFi” or the “Company”), the first U.S. publicly listed DeFi company building on Hyperliquid, today reported results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“We are pleased to report a third consecutive quarter of record Net Income and, importantly, our first quarter of breakeven-or-better core operating profit and cash flows, achieved one quarter ahead of our initial 2026 year-end target”, said Hyunsu Jung, CEO of Hyperion DeFi. Mr. Jung continued, “With our legacy debt now retired, share repurchases underway, and our core operations having achieved the inflection point we promised since day one, we continue to position ourselves as the premier institutional gateway to DeFi innovation as we deliver on our mission to revolutionize blockchain financial services.”

**HYPD Investment Thesis & 15-Month Trailing Results**


In June of 2025, Hyperion DeFi evolved its operating strategy to the acquisition of HYPE and directly building in the Hyperliquid ecosystem. We made a firm commitment that we would be more than just HYPE, benefitting from not just holding the asset, but uniquely building multiple business atop it that have the potential to maximize its profitability. Our model is no longer a concept that we ask investors to envision, it has become reality.


Our unique strategy shares in multiple frontiers of value creation at the same time. Those three frontiers include (1) Asset Value – our HYPE Treasury, (2) Operating Value – our DeFi Businesses, and (3) Option Value – our embedded economic upside in the Hyperliquid ecosystem. We call this our HYPD “Triple-Dip” Strategy, and we believe our results over the past fifteen months speak for themselves.


- **Growing HYPE Treasury:** From June 2025 to September 2026, our Gross HYPE Tokens(2) have increased 41% from 1.31 million to 1.85 million HYPE Tokens, even after selling HYPE in Q3 to help retire our legacy debt. Over the same period, our Net Asset Value(9) has grown 338% from $41.6 million to $182.4 million.


- **Five Scalable Businesses:** From Q3 2025 to Q3 2026, our quarterly Adjusted Gross Profit(1) has grown 536% from $0.4 million to $2.8 million as our DeFi businesses have ramped. We have earned more than 2x, and as much as 3.6x, base HYPE staking yield in each of the last four quarters.


- **Embedded Economic Upside in the Hyperliquid Ecosystem:** We have received tokens, equity, or future rights to tokens or equity in multiple early-stage builders and infrastructure partners on Hyperliquid: Kinetiq, HyperLend, Silhouette, Skew, and DoubleZero. In September, we also became entitled to an allocation of DOMA tokens through our work with D3, and expect to continue providing ecosystem access to HYPD holders.


- **Declining Cost Base:** From Q3 2025 to Q3 2026, our Operating Expenses Excluding Stock-Based Compensation(5) declined 48% from $4.3 million to $2.2 million, and Core Operating Earnings(19) swung from a loss of $3.9 million to positive $0.6 million. Our legacy biotech segment has been wound down, and in July we sold all remaining Optejet IP to Arctic Vision.


- **Improving Cash Flows:** From Q3 2025 to Q3 2026, quarterly Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow(18) has improved from ($2.8 million) to positive $0.1 million, both as a function of reduced costs and ramping DeFi businesses. We delivered positive Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow(18) in Q3, ahead of our year-end target.


- **Optimizing Capital Structure:** In Q3 we repaid all outstanding principal and interest on our Avenue Capital loan (approximately $8.6 million), retiring all of our legacy debt, and we have begun repurchasing our shares under the $20 million buyback program announced on September 8. We ended Q3 with $14.5 million of cash, cash equivalents, and stablecoins(16) and no long-term debt outstanding.


- **Guidance:** We are reiterating our anticipated $7 million to $8 million Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in 2026, approximately 6x our 2025 FY results.


**Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26 and Q2’26**


Adjusted Gross Profit(1), a Non-GAAP Metric, aims to capture all of Hyperion DeFi’s value-add operating business activities beyond gains and losses in our digital asset treasury. In total, Adjusted Gross Profit(1) increased +143% quarter-over-quarter to $2.80 million in Q3’26 from $1.15 million in Q2’26, above the $2.0 million to $2.5 million range we guided to on September 8, 2026. Excluding Ecosystem Rewards, which can vary materially quarter-to-quarter, Adjusted Gross Profit(1) grew 45% quarter-over-quarter, and we earned 3.6x base staking yield in Q3’26. Four of our five segments grew quarter-over-quarter, and four of five achieved all-time company highs over the past 5 quarters. Below is a summary of all five of our operating business activities included within Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in these periods:


1. **Staking Yield: We stake our HYPE to our Validator and earn rewards.**


- On a dollar basis, our HYPE earned from staking (10,313 HYPE tokens) generated $785 thousand Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26 versus $527 thousand in Q2’26 (+49% quarter-over-quarter), largely driven by an increase in the Effective Average HYPE Price In-Period(3) to 75.9 in Q3’26 from 51.2 in Q2’26.


2. **Validator Commissions: The Company operates its Validator under a Joint Validator Operators Agreement (together with Kinetiq and MAVAN) and earns commissions on rewards delivered to third-party tokens delegated to the Validator .**


- On a dollar basis, our HYPE earned from validator commissions (572 HYPE tokens) generated $41 thousand Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26 versus $42 thousand in Q2’26 (roughly flat quarter-over-quarter).


- Approximately 6.3 million HYPE tokens were delegated to our Validator as of October 31, 2026(2).


- Blockdaemon and Gemini have both chosen our validator for delegated HYPE staking through their respective platforms.


- We continue to see multiple opportunities for validator growth, driven by the products and services we are creating plus demand from institutions for world-class validator infrastructure.


- In total, the Company earned approximately 10.9 thousand HYPE tokens from staking and validating activities in Q3’26, roughly in line with 11.1 thousand in Q2’26(2).


3. **Yield Enhancement: The Company pursues accretive strategies to enhance yield earned on its tokens.**


- Yield Enhancement activities generated $381 thousand Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26 versus $334 thousand in Q2’26 (+14% quarter-over-quarter).


- Q3’26 and Q2’26 Yield Enhancement activities primarily monetized HYPE volatility through multiple strategies OTC and on-chain, including within our Institutional Volatility Income (IVI) Vault in partnership with the Rysk protocol.


- We are also earning Rysk points from our vault activity and may become eligible for future Rysk tokens, while building the infrastructure to accommodate third-party execution and integrations within Rysk Premium in the future.


4. **DeFi Monetization: The Company supports and monetizes Hyperliquid DeFi activity with sustainable, scalable practices.**


- Quarterly Results: DeFi Monetization activity generated $334 thousand Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26, an increase of +112% versus $158 thousand in Q2’26 and a record for the company.


- HAUS Redeployment: As previously disclosed, the sunset of the USDH stablecoin in June 2026 opened up 800,000 of our HYPE tokens to be redeployed. In our last earnings release we noted that we had redeployed 1 million HYPE tokens into new HAUS partnerships since June 2026, including Entropy (HIP-3) and Skew (HIP-4), and that we expected those new deployments over time to position us better than before. We have now proven this out in Q3’26, with DeFi Monetization achieving a record for the company.


- Data Services: On September 24, 2026, we helped DoubleZero launch the fastest commercially available Hyperliquid data feeds, which gives us a new Data Services business on our Validator Operations that earns future revenue from publishing Hyperliquid market data.


- HAUS-Skew (HIP-4): Our HAUS agreement with Skew Technologies allocates 500,000 of our staked HYPE to support the deployment of HIP-4 outcome markets. The Skew team has put their markets RFQ into production, incorporating feedback from Hyperliquid that both improves capital efficiency for market makers on their platform and enables multi-leg orders for options and parlays. We expect this to simplify participation in outcome markets on Hyperliquid, and see growing interest across Partner Markets, distribution agreements and multiple market maker onboardings in the immediate pipeline.


- HAUS-Entropy (HIP-3): In August 2026 we announced a HAUS partnership with Entropy with 500,000 of our staked HYPE. Our deal with Entropy supports HIP-3 perpetuals futures markets, which have seen strong growth over the past three months, with over $3B of volume traded and daily open interest above $80M. Pre-IPO trading for Anthropic has been their most successful market, and a testament to their unique market design methodology for enabling the asset to trade prior to Anthropic’s upcoming IPO. They currently maintain the second largest share of Hyperliquid’s HIP-3 markets and we expect them to release additional updates over the coming months that enhance the accessibility of their markets.


- HAUS-Silhouette (Trading Fee Reduction): In March 2026 we launched a HAUS agreement on 100,000 HYPE tokens with Silhouette, whereby Silhouette receives reduced trading fees for their clients and we receive a portion of those savings as revenue. Silhouette (which provides block and shielded trading on Hyperliquid to its clients) completed its migration into production in Q2’26. We saw monthly volumes step up from the hundreds of thousands toward over $110 million cumulative to date. This was driven by Silhouette’s support for RWA spot trading such as xStocks, which we expect to continue to accelerate on Hyperliquid as more assets become tokenized and move on-chain.


- HAUS Pipeline: We maintain our pipeline of prospective HAUS clients and continue to be selective, prioritizing structures that return durable, volume-linked value to our supported markets. The value of natively staked HYPE continues to be demonstrated across these services.


- On-Chain Credit: On September 30, 2026, together with Anchorage Digital and HyperLend, we announced the first institutional credit facility on Aviya, secured by natively staked HYPE that remains in qualified custody at Anchorage Digital Bank. We expect the Aviya platform to scale as demand grows for institutional borrowing and lending against robust collateral, and we are entitled to a revenue share on a portion of future activity on Aviya.


5. **Ecosystem Rewards: Through our active participation in the Hyperliquid DeFi ecosystem, the Company positions itself for the receipt of future potential token airdrops, protocol incentives, and other rewards that may become available periodically.**


- Ecosystem Rewards generated $1.3 million Adjusted Gross Profit(1) in Q3’26, versus $90 thousand in Q2’26. Q3’26 is our largest quarter to date of Ecosystem Rewards, and this is now the fourth consistent quarter of activity in this segment.


- We continue to expect the quarter-over-quarter change in Ecosystem Rewards to be volatile given the unexpected timing of airdrops, token generation events, and other rewards activity.


- The Q3’26 figure reflects two elements: (1) $505 thousand for the 10 million 2Z tokens we received from DoubleZero in September 2026 pursuant to our strategic agreement, and (2) $750 thousand for the Skew equity we are contractually owed, valued based on Skew’s most recent raise.


- In November 2025, we received 1.92 million KNTQ tokens in Kinetiq’s airdrop token generation event. We staked KNTQ with Kinetiq and earned more KNTQ tokens over time, having accrued approximately 64,000 additional KNTQ tokens. On October 11, 2026, we exercised our right to purchase 490 thousand additional KNTQ tokens at a discount basis of $0.26, bringing our overall position to approximately 2.5 million KNTQ tokens valued at approximately $750 thousand, versus our basis of $128 thousand.


- In March 2026, we received 10 million HPL tokens from HyperLend in connection with partnership and revenue-sharing agreements in connection with on-chain credit pools.


- In September 2026, we received 10 million 2Z tokens from DoubleZero pursuant to our strategic agreement.


- In September 2026, as a launch partner for D3’s Frontier Vault, we became entitled to an allocation of DOMA tokens from a potential future token generation event.


- Silhouette is contractually obligated to award HYPD at least 1% of future token supply or equity.


- As part of our HAUS agreement with Skew, Skew is contractually obligated to award HYPD at least 5% Skew equity plus 5% of Skew token supply to the extent there is a future Skew token generation event.


- Given our partnerships with other Hyperliquid ecosystem participants such as Rysk, we expect our list of ecosystem positions to continue to grow as we deepen our partnerships and relationships across the Hyperliquid ecosystem.


**Q3’26 and Q2’26 Expense Summary Results**


- Operating Expenses Excluding Stock-Based Compensation(5) declined (4%) quarter-over-quarter to $2.2 million in Q3’26 from $2.3 million in Q2’26, within our guided range of $2.0 million to $2.25 million.


- $2.2 million Operating Expenses Excluding Stock-Based Compensation(5) in Q3’26 represents a (48%) decline versus $4.3 million in Q3’25, our first quarter since adopting our DeFi strategy.


- Because Adjusted Gross Profit(1) exceeded these expenses, Core Operating Earnings(19) was positive $0.6 million in Q3’26, our first positive quarter since adopting our DeFi strategy and above the $0 to $0.5 million range we guided to, versus a loss of $1.2 million in Q2’26 (a +$1.7 million quarterly swing in core profitability).


**Q3’26 and Q2’26 Treasury Summary**


- Gross HYPE Tokens(2) decreased to 1.85 million in Q3’26 from 2.04 million in Q2’26, as we sold HYPE in the quarter primarily to fund the retirement of our legacy debt.


- Gross HYPE Holdings(4) increased to $167.9 million in Q3’26 from $132.6 million in Q2’26, as the price of HYPE increased to $90.8 in Q3’26 from $65.0 in Q2’26. At $90.8, our Gross HYPE Holdings exceeded the $74.0 million aggregate basis(14) of our HYPE tokens ($40.0 per token) by approximately $94 million.


- Net Asset Value(9), which adjusts our treasury value for net cash and debt, increased to $182.4 million in Q3’26 from $134.2 million in Q2’26.


- Treasury Gains (Losses)(6) was $48.1 million in Q3’26 versus $54.8 million in Q2’26.


**Q3’26 and Q2’26 Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA(8)**


- Q3’26 Net Income was $39.6 million, a third sequential quarterly record for the company, versus $31.0 million in Q2’26.


- Q3’26 Adjusted EBITDA(8) of $48.7 million compares to $53.7 million in Q2’26.


- The primary reconciliation of Net Income to Adjusted EBITDA(8) continues to be driven by our Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), for which the GAAP carrying value is the low-water-mark price of the underlying native token, as detailed further in our GAAP to Non-GAAP reconciliations section at the end of this release. The in-period adjustment was $5.7 million in Q3’26 (including approximately $0.6 million related to KNTQ LSTs, which are included beginning in Q3’26), versus $21.8 million in Q2’26, which is the main reason Adjusted EBITDA(8) declined while Net Income grew.


- If all of our HYPE LSTs were converted back to HYPE at the end of Q3’26, we believe that would have increased our GAAP Net Income by approximately $38.3 million.


- Q3’26 Net Income per Common Share of $1.24 on a basic basis (15,701,943 weighted average shares) and $1.23 on a diluted basis (15,747,615 weighted average shares) compares to Q2’26 Net Income per Common Share of $1.01 on a basic basis (14,173,457 weighted average shares) and $0.92 on a diluted basis (17,066,826 weighted average shares).


- As of November 9, 2026, there are approximately 15.5 million outstanding shares of HYPD common stock.


**Q3’26 and Q2’26 Cash Flows Summary**


- Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow(18) was positive $0.1 million in Q3’26, our first positive quarter, versus ($2.1 million) in Q2’26.


- Adjusted Net Investing Cash Flow(17) was $12.8 million in Q3’26 versus ($6.2 million) in Q2’26, primarily reflecting approximately $13 million of HYPE sales and no HYPE purchases in the quarter.


- Net Cash Used in Financing Activities was ($10.1 million) in Q3’26, primarily the repayment of our Avenue Capital loan and share repurchases, versus $11.0 million provided in Q2’26 (primarily from our May 2026 public offering).


- Our cash, cash equivalents, and stablecoins(16) totaled $14.5 million as of Q3’26 versus $11.8 million as of Q2’26, even after retiring our debt.


**Q3’26 Capital Structure and Shareholder Returns**


- In Q3’26 we repaid all outstanding principal and interest on our Avenue Capital loan, approximately $8.6 million, retiring all of our legacy debt. We now have no long-term debt outstanding.


- The payoff was funded in part with HYPE sales: we sold approximately $13 million of HYPE in Q3’26 and still ended the quarter with more cash, cash equivalents, and stablecoins(16) than we started with.


- On September 8, 2026 we announced a share repurchase program of up to $20 million over the following 12 months. As announced on October 2, 2026, we have since commenced executing share buybacks, having repurchased in September 240,124 shares at approximately a 30% discount to our net assets.

**About the Hyperliquid Platform and the HYPE Token**


Hyperliquid is a next-generation layer one blockchain optimized for high frequency, transparent trading. The blockchain includes fully on-chain perpetual futures and spot order books, with every order, cancel, trade, and liquidation occurring within 70 millisecond block times. It also hosts the HyperEVM, a general-purpose smart contract platform that supports permissionless decentralized financial applications akin to Ethereum.


HYPE is the native token of Hyperliquid. Staked HYPE provides utility for users via reduced trading fees and increased referral bonuses. As of October 31, 2026, approximately 48 million HYPE have been autonomously purchased and sequestered by the blockchain with the trading fees generated on the network’s central limit order books.


**About Hyperion DeFi, Inc.**


Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is the first U.S. publicly listed DeFi company building on Hyperliquid. 4. *“Gross HYPE Holdings” is a non-GAAP measure. It is reconciled to the GAAP measure “HYPE digital assets” by adding (i) HYPE digital assets receivable (without subtracting allowance for credit loss or unamortized nonrefundable upfront fees), (ii) HYPE digital intangible assets receivable (without subtracting allowance for credit loss), (iii) HYPE LSTs at carrying value (including without limitation HiHYPE, kHYPE, and kmHYPE) and (iv) the unrealized accretion (dilution) expected upon LST to HYPE reconversion as of the end of each respective reporting quarter. We believe Gross HYPE Holdings is a helpful non-GAAP financial measure to our management and investors because it eliminates the temporary HYPE value impacts caused by our DeFi Monetization and Yield Enhancement token movements as well as the conversion and reconversion between HYPE tokens and LSTs, which (a) causes staking yield on our HYPE LSTs not to be recognized in-period in accordance with GAAP and (b) does not recognize upward mark-to-market movements in underlying HYPE tokens given LSTs are carried at the lower of cost basis or impaired value. 5. *"Operating Expenses Excluding Stock-Based Compensation" is a non-GAAP measure. It is reconciled to the GAAP measure “Selling, general and administrative expense” by (i) subtracting stock-based compensation expense and (ii) adding research and development expense. Operating Expenses Excluding Stock-Based Compensation provides a metric of total operating expenditures in-period without the impact of treasury value movements, stock-based compensation, or impairment of right of use assets, thereby creating a helpful metric for operational expense comparisons between different periods for our management and investors.*
6. *"Treasury Gains (Losses)" is a non-GAAP measure. It is reconciled to the GAAP measure “Net Operating Income (Expenses)" by (a) adding (i) research and development expense, (ii) selling, general, and administrative expense, (iii) impairment of right of use assets, (iv) provision for credit losses, and (v) the in-period change in unrealized accretion (dilution) expected upon LST to native token reconversion (including HYPE LSTs beginning in Q3’25 and KNTQ LSTs beginning in Q3’26), and (b) subtracting (i) accumulated but unrealized staking yield on LSTs, (ii) income from airdrops, (iii) realized gains and losses from Rysk Vault shares redemption, (iv) net gains on derivative instruments, and (v) treasury value changes attributable to derivative activity (which are already captured in the Non-GAAP metric “Adjusted Gross Profit”). We believe Adjusted Net Investing Cash Flow is a helpful non-GAAP financial measure to our management and investors because it removes the in-period cash flow volatility which can be caused by purchases and sales of and by non-cash current assets, including USDC and USDH stablecoins. The Company believes Adjusted Net Investing Cash Flow provides useful information about our financial performance and cash flows with greater transparency for investors to understand and compare our operating results across accounting periods.*
18. *“Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow” is a non-GAAP measure. Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow is defined as the estimated total net cash (including non-GAAP cash equivalents) generated from / (used for) the Company’s operating activities. It is reconciled to the GAAP measure “Net Cash and Cash Equivalents Provided By Operating Activities” by (a) subtracting the net impact of non-cash digital asset acquisitions and dispositions and (b) adding quarterly variance in assets the Company considers to be economically equivalent, but not functionally equivalent, to cash (including from time-to-time USDC and USDH stablecoins as well as deposits and redemptions from the Hyperion Rysk Vault). We believe Adjusted Net Operating Cash Flow is a helpful non-GAAP financial measure to our management and investors because it removes the in-period operating cash flow volatility which can be caused by the inflows and outflows of non-GAAP current assets functionally equivalent to cash.*
19. *“Core Operating Earnings” is a non-GAAP measure. Core Operating Earnings is defined as all in-period gross profit less operational expenses incurred by the Company excluding gains and losses on its digital asset treasury, stock-based compensation, and impairment of right of use assets. It is reconciled to the GAAP measure “Gross Profit” as adjusted to non-GAAP “Adjusted Gross Profit” (described more fully in Footnote 1) by (i) adding selling, general and administrative expense, (ii) subtracting stock-based compensation expense, and (iii) adding research and development expense. Core Operating Earnings provides a metric of total operating earnings in-period without the impact of treasury value movements, stock-based compensation, or impairment of right of use assets. We believe Core Operating Earnings is a helpful metric to our management and investors to compare core operating activity across periods.*
